name: Marketplace, Ride-Hailing & SuperApp Ops
description: Screens merchant catalog listings for prohibited terms, prompt-injection payloads, and price outliers, attributes on-demand delivery SLA breaches across merchant prep vs courier transit with force-majeure waivers, and reconciles merchant GMV, commission fees, FX, and PSP settlements.

skills.summary: Detects indirect prompt injection in merchant copy, screens counterfeit/prohibited goods, flags price outliers, and checks attributes.
Splits order delays into merchant prep vs courier transit faults, waives verified weather delays, and assigns refund liability.
Reconciles gross GMV, commission take-rates, promo splits, FX conversions, and PSP wires while flagging negative clawbacks.

byo_mcp: PSP Settlement Ledger & Marketplace Catalog MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull pending merchant catalog SKU feeds, delivery leg timestamps, and PSP payout settlement batches from BigQuery/Postgres or customer Marketplace/PSP MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before running Python trust and ledger reconciliation.

gateway_approval_actions: Suspending merchants, delisting SKUs, or issuing SLA penalties via Marketplace Catalog MCP
Releasing merchant payout bank batches or SLA refund transfers via PSP Settlement MCP
python_code_guardrails: Prompt-injection quarantine and price-sanity outlier / forbidden-keyword listing block inside catalog descriptions
Merchant-prep vs courier-transit delay fault attribution preventing false SLA penalties
Clawback negative-balance hold and multi-currency FX payout tie-out within tolerance

scheduled_routine.name: daily-payout-settlement-recon
scheduled_routine.title: Daily Payout Settlement Reconciliation
